name: Data storytelling
purpose: It makes complex information easier to understand and actionable for a broad audience, bridging the gap between technical analysis and decision-making. Data storytelling transforms raw data into compelling narratives that resonate with audiences, driving action and informed decisions.
keyCapabilities: Enhances comprehension and understanding of complex data
Facilitates effective communication and cross-team collaboration
Highlights key insights and explains the "why" behind the numbers
integrations: Business Intelligence (BI) platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker)
Presentation and Infographic tools (e.g., Infogram, Datawrapper)
Data Sources (CRM, ERP, web analytics, corporate databases)
AI-augmented analytics tools (machine learning, natural language processing)
useCases: Explaining quarterly performance, customer trends, or operational results in business settings
Public reports on population changes or environmental conditions for government and non-profits
Marketing campaigns (e.g., Spotify Wrapped, Starbucks App, Google Year in Search)

researchPapers.title: What Do We Mean When We Talk About Data Storytelling?
researchPapers.authors: Leni Yang, Zezhong Wang, Xingyu Lan
